LanguageData.CA_LoreBook_Opening: The Marked Virus did not raise the dead. It left people alive, clever, cruel, and organized enough to end worlds.
LanguageData.CA_LoreBook_ResearchNote: Field diagnostics identify a fast terminal pattern: most victims resolve quickly into either Marked Men transformation or viral collapse, while rare slow cases last longer.
LanguageData.CA_MilitaryReport_01: Military Report 01: Infected subjects retain weapon use, speech, door operation, cover-seeking behavior, and group tactics. Do not approach as medical casualties.
LanguageData.CA_MilitaryReport_02: Military Report 02: Alphas coordinate nearby infected by sound, gesture, and remembered command structure. Remove Alpha units first whenever possible.
LanguageData.CA_SurvivorJournal_01: Survivor Journal: They did not forget us. That was the first lesson. The second was that they knew which doors we locked.
LanguageData.CA_AudioLog_01: Audio Log C-44: Rash presentation forms a marked vascular pattern across the face and neck. Advanced cases glow red under certain scanner bands.
LanguageData.CA_PlanetaryTimeline: Medical timeline: contagious close-contact exposure, infected blood contamination, fast terminal progression, rare slow infection, uncommon immune survival, viral death risk, and Marked Men transformation.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_Intro: Use presets for a quick difficulty pass, or tune each section directly. Editing any field changes the active preset to Custom.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_PresetHelp: Presets rewrite the schedule, enemy mix, virus behavior, AI pressure, story UI, and performance settings at once.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_Preset_CasualTip: Slower raids, lower exposure risk, smaller hordes, and more immune survivors.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_Preset_VanillaLikeTip: Keeps the faction dangerous while staying closer to ordinary RimWorld pacing.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_Preset_DefaultTip: Restores the intended baseline tuning for the mod.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_Preset_BrutalTip: Faster, harder, less forgiving raids with stronger infection pressure.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_Preset_OutbreakTip: Large outbreak pressure with faster spread, larger hordes, and faster corpse cycling.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_Preset_VeryEasyTip: Slower raids, lower exposure risk, smaller hordes, and more immune survivors.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_Preset_EasyTip: Keeps the faction dangerous while staying closer to ordinary RimWorld pacing.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_Preset_NormalTip: Restores the intended baseline tuning for the mod.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_Preset_HardTip: Faster, harder, less forgiving raids with stronger infection pressure.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_Preset_VeryHardTip: Large outbreak pressure with faster spread, larger hordes, and faster corpse cycling.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_InfectColonistsDesc: When enabled, your own colonists can be infected by the Marked Virus. Disable to make colonists immune to new infections.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_InfectAlliesDesc: When enabled, allied, neutral, and guest pawns can be infected by the Marked Virus. Disable to protect non-hostile non-colonists.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_InfectEnemiesDesc: When enabled, hostile pawns like raiders can be infected by the Marked Virus. Disable to prevent the virus from spreading to enemy factions.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_RaidScheduleDesc: Controls when Marked Men incidents appear and how hard scheduled attacks scale.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_EnemyMixDesc: Controls which infected pawn types appear. Weight 0 disables that type; weight 1 is normal; higher values make that type more common.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_VirusAndCorpsesDesc: Controls exposure chances, infection timing, terminal outcomes, and infected corpse transformation.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_AIStorytellingDesc: Controls Marked Men pressure logic, strategic AI activation thresholds, storyteller integration, raid countdown warnings, and custom story events.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_PerformanceCapDesc: Controls maximum simultaneous infected, cleanup intervals, corpse removal rates, world pawn tracking limits, and performance optimization settings.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_UrbanBiomeDesc: Controls Marked Men presence in urban maps: ambush frequency, dormant infestation density, epicenter encounters, and survivor spawn chances.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_UINotificationsDesc: Controls which messages, alerts, letters, gizmos, and info cards the mod shows in the user interface.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_ResetTip: Reset all settings to their default values.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_CoreDesc: Global switches for infection and compatibility diagnostics. These do not remove existing hediffs from a save.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_AllowNewInfectionsDes: When disabled, this mod stops creating new Marked Virus exposure events. Existing infections continue to run normally.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_LogCompatibilityMods: Log detected compatibility mods on load
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_LogCompatibilityModsD: Writes a short compatibility scan to the RimWorld log after loading. Leave this off unless you are troubleshooting.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_EnableWarbandsDesc: Allows the main timed Marked Men raids that escalate over the colony timeline.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_EnableHordesDesc: Allows larger moving horde events in addition to the main warband schedule.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_EnableProbesDesc: Allows small scouting packs that test the colony before larger attacks arrive.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_RandomizeRaids: Randomize raid timing and arrival patterns
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_RandomizeRaidsDesc: Adds uncertainty to raid intervals and arrival modes. Disable this for predictable testing or calmer pacing.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_firstMarkedRaidDayDes: When did the infection begin? The chronometer flickers. The Marked will come when they are ready.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_markedRaidFrequencyMu: Master multiplier for warbands, hordes, and probes. Set this to 0 to stop all scheduled Marked Men incidents.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_warbandFrequencyMulti: Multiplier for main warband raids after the global multiplier is applied.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_hordeFrequencyMultipl: Multiplier for horde events after the global multiplier is applied.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_probeFrequencyMultipl: Multiplier for small probe incidents after the global multiplier is applied.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_raidPointsMultiplierD: Scales incident points after the minimum point floor is applied.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_minimumRaidPointsDesc: Point floor for generated Marked Men attacks. Higher values make even early raids larger.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_maximumRaidPointsDesc: Hard point ceiling for generated Marked Men attacks. Prevents extreme late-game raids from exceeding this value.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_raidEscalationPerRaid: Extra raid strength added after each scheduled warband starts.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_raidEscalationMaxBonu: Maximum accumulated escalation bonus from repeated warbands.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_GroupedEdgeArrivalsDe: Allows raiders to enter together from one map edge.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_SplitGroupEdgeArrival: Allows several groups to enter from different edge positions.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_ScatteredEdgeArrivals: Allows a wider scattered edge arrival pattern.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_SingleEdgeArrivalsDes: Allows single-file edge entry when the incident worker selects it.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_civilianWeightMultipl: Basic infected with improvised weapons. The most common type.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_scoutWeightMultiplier: Fast reconnaissance infected with light weapons.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_shooterWeightMultipli: Ranged infected with sidearms and SMGs.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_raiderWeightMultiplie: Former bandits with assault rifles and machetes.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_soldierWeightMultipli: Former military infected with military-grade gear.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_bruteWeightMultiplier: Heavy melee infected. Usually appears only when raid points are high enough.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_alphaWeightMultiplier: Elite command infected that strengthens nearby Marked Men.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_warlordWeightMultipli: Regional commander infected. Rare and extremely dangerous.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_markedManWeightMultip: Ultimate infected. Endgame encounter, extremely rare.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_minimumHordeSizeDesc: Smallest horde size when a horde incident does not request a specific count.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_maximumHordeSizeDesc: Largest horde size after threat scaling and variance.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_minimumProbeSizeDesc: Smallest scouting pack size when the incident does not request a specific count.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_maximumProbeSizeDesc: Largest scouting pack size after threat scaling and variance.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_maximumAlphasPerRaidD: Hard cap for alpha infected in generated raids. Set to 0 to prevent alphas from spawning.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_bloodExposureChanceDe: Chance that infected blood exposure creates a Marked Virus exposure event.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_foodExposureChanceDes: Chance that eating contaminated food creates a Marked Virus exposure event.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_infectedAssaultExposu: Chance that direct infected assault contact creates a Marked Virus exposure event.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_closeContactExposureC: Chance per valid nearby target during a contagion pulse from an infected pawn.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_corpseContaminationCh: Chance that an infected pawn contaminates a nearby corpse during a corpse contamination pulse.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_infectionProgressionS: Higher values make the disease advance faster. Lower values give victims more time.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_incubationDurationMul: Multiplies infection stage durations before progression speed is applied.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_immunitySurvivalChanc: Chance that a terminal infection ends in lasting immunity instead of transformation or viral death.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_terminalTransformatio: Relative weight for becoming one of the Marked Men when immunity does not save the pawn.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_terminalDeathWeightDe: Relative weight for dying from viral collapse when immunity does not save the pawn.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_TerminalOutcome: Current terminal outcome after the immunity roll: {0} transform, {1} die.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_reanimationChanceDesc: Chance that a valid infected corpse transforms after death. No corpse remains.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_reanimationDelayTicks: Delay before queued infected corpses can transform. 60,000 ticks equals one in-game day.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_starterLineageBreakth: Chance that special starter-lineage resistance fails after direct exposure.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_InfectionTransmission: Controls how the Marked Virus spreads through combat. Ranged transmission is disabled by default and can be enabled below. Explosions and turrets never transmit infection.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_EnableMeleeTransmissi: Master toggle for all melee-based infection transmission. When disabled, no melee attack can spread the Marked Virus.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_BiteTransmissionDesc: When enabled, bite attacks from infected pawns can transmit the virus.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_biteInfectionChanceDe: Chance that a bite attack from an infected pawn transmits the Marked Virus.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_ClawTransmissionDesc: When enabled, claw attacks from infected pawns can transmit the virus.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_clawInfectionChanceDe: Chance that a claw or stab attack from an infected pawn transmits the Marked Virus.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_ScratchTransmissionDe: When enabled, scratch attacks from infected pawns can transmit the virus.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_scratchInfectionChanc: Chance that a scratch attack from an infected pawn transmits the Marked Virus.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_PunchTransmissionDesc: When enabled, punch and blunt attacks from infected pawns can transmit the virus.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_punchInfectionChanceD: Chance that a punch or blunt attack from an infected pawn transmits the Marked Virus.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_MeleeWeaponTransmissi: When enabled, melee weapon attacks from infected pawns can transmit the virus.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_meleeWeaponInfectionC: Chance that a melee weapon attack from an infected pawn transmits the Marked Virus.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_MarkedMenGuaranteedDe: When enabled, fully transformed Marked Men always infect on melee contact.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_markedMenInfectionCha: Chance that a fully transformed Marked Man transmits the virus on melee contact. Used when guaranteed infection is disabled.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_EnableRangedTransmiss: When enabled, ranged attacks from infected pawns can transmit the Marked Virus. Disabled by default.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_rangedInfectionChance: Chance that a ranged attack from an infected pawn transmits the Marked Virus.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_SealedApparelDesc: Toggling a category off removes full viral immunity for that apparel type, reverting to partial resistance instead.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_WarcasketsBlockDesc: When enabled, any warcasket torso shell provides full immunity to direct Marked Virus exposure. Disable this if you want warcasket pawns to still face infection risk.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_VacsuitBlockDesc: When enabled, wearing both a vacsuit body and helmet provides full immunity via the sealed combo. Disable to make the combo only give partial resistance.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_GasMasksBlockDesc: When enabled, gas masks, HAZMAT masks, and toxin-immune headgear provide full immunity. Disable for partial resistance only.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_SealedArmorBlockDesc: When enabled, HAZMAT suits, sealed undersuits, security armor, and orbital armor provide full immunity. Disable for partial resistance only.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_InfectedAIDesc: Controls how aggressively Marked Men attack, retarget, breach, and terrorize nearby pawns.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_TacticalRetargetingDe: Lets infected pawns periodically switch to better tactical targets.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_PriorityTargetingDesc: Lets infected pawns prefer power, food, medical, research, and turret targets when appropriate.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_DoorTargetingDesc: Allows infected pawns to bash or target barriers when pursuing a colony.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_infightingChanceDesc: Chance during each infighting check that infected pawns may turn on each other.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_socialTerrorStrengthD: Scales the radius and strength of Marked Men terror effects. Set to 0 to disable these effects.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_PredatoryInstinctsDes: Controls the bloodlust, kill anticipation, and predator psychology systems for the Marked Ones.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_BloodlustSystemDesc: When enabled, infected pawns build bloodlust over time and gain mood and combat effects based on their craving for violence.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_bloodlustDecayRateDes: How quickly bloodlust fades when not in combat. Lower values keep pawns bloodthirsty longer.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_bloodlustKillGainMult: How much a kill or down satisfies bloodlust. Higher values mean faster satiation.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_bloodlustCombatGainMu: How much active combat feeds bloodlust. Set to 0 to disable combat-based bloodlust gain.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_KillAnticipationDesc: When enabled, infected pawns gain combat bonuses from anticipating enemies nearby. Effects fade quickly when out of combat.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_anticipationGainMulti: How quickly kill anticipation builds when enemies are near.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_anticipationDecayMult: How quickly kill anticipation fades after combat ends. Higher values fade faster.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_MessagesAndDevToolsDe: Controls player-facing alerts, incident history, and optional debug actions.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_RaidCountdownDesc: Shows a gizmo alert when a scheduled Marked Men raid is approaching.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_raidCountdownVisibleD: How many in-game days before a scheduled raid the countdown alert becomes visible.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_raidCountdownHighPrio: How many in-game days before a scheduled raid the alert becomes high priority.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_DetailedLettersDesc: Adds richer raid letter text with pawn counts, points, arrival mode, and tactical warning details.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_IncidentLogDesc: Stores Marked Men incident history in the game component for debugging and future review.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_DebugActionsDesc: Adds Dev Mode actions for starting or rescheduling Marked Men incidents while testing.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_PerformanceDesc: Controls how often background systems run. Higher intervals reduce CPU work but make reactions less immediate.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_contagionPulseInterva: How often infected pawns try nearby close-contact exposure checks.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_maxContagionTargetsPe: Maximum nearby pawns checked by each contagion pulse. Set to 0 to disable pulse-based close-contact spread.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_corpseContaminationIn: How often infected pawns try to contaminate nearby corpses.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_maxCorpsesPerPulseDes: Maximum nearby corpses checked during each corpse contamination pulse. Set to 0 to disable corpse contamination.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_tacticalRetargetInter: How often infected pawns can reconsider tactical targets. Higher values improve performance by reducing scans for new targets.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_infightingCheckInterv: How often infected pawns can roll for infighting behavior.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_lordCleanupIntervalTi: How often the mod cleans up invalid raid lord state.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_infectedStateMaintena: How often infected pawns refresh state such as faction-specific visuals.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_reanimationProcessInt: How often queued corpse transformations are processed.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_maxPendingReanimation: Limits burst work when many infected corpses are waiting to transform.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_UrbanOutbreakDesc: Controls Marked Virus outbreaks in Ancient Urban Ruins cities. Only applies when the Ancient Urban Ruins mod is active.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_UrbanOutbreaksDesc: Toggles whether Ancient Urban Ruins maps become active outbreak zones with infected Marked Men roaming the ruins.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_urbanInfectionDensity: Controls how many buildings become infected and how many Marked Men spawn per building. Higher values mean denser urban populations.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_urbanAmbushFrequencyD: How often Marked Men ambushes occur inside the ruins. Higher values mean more frequent attacks.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_DormantInfestationsDe: When enabled, some infected buildings start dormant. They burst open with Marked Men when colonists approach.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_dormantInfestationFre: How many buildings start with dormant infestations waiting to ambush approaching colonists.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_CityEpicentersDesc: When enabled, some urban ruin maps become high-density epicenters with stronger, more frequent spawns and a world-object reinforcement comp.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_epicenterSpawnChanceD: Chance that a given urban ruins map becomes an epicenter with doubled initial population and periodic reinforcements.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_UrbanAmbushesDesc: Allows incident-driven ambush events on Ancient Urban Ruins maps in addition to map-component ambushes.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_SurvivorEncountersDes: When enabled, survivor encounters in the ruins may be genuine survivors, hidden infected, or traps leading to infestations.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_survivorEncounterChan: Multiplier for survivor encounter incident frequency in urban ruins. Higher values mean more survivor events.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_AURSpawnProtectionDes: Controls enemy spawn positions on Ancient Urban Ruins maps. Prevents enemies from appearing too close to colonists by redirecting their spawn positions to map edges or a minimum distance away.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_SpawnProtectionDesc: When enabled, enemies spawning on Ancient Urban Ruins maps are placed at a safer minimum distance from colonists, animals, and mechs. Only applies when Ancient Urban Ruins is loaded.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_aurMinimumSpawnDistan: Minimum distance in cells that enemies must be kept from any colonist, animal, or mech. Higher values give more reaction time but may reduce valid spawn positions.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_PreferEdgeSpawnDesc: When enabled, the patch tries to spawn enemies from map edges first. Falls back to distance-based placement if all edge cells are blocked by ruins or mountains.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_SpawnDebugLoggingDesc: Writes detailed spawn protection debug messages to the RimWorld log. Useful for troubleshooting spawn placement issues.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_LostSurvivorsDesc: Controls the Lost Survivor incident. A seemingly normal colonist joins but carries a dormant Marked Virus infection that may activate days or weeks later with unpredictable consequences.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_LostSurvivorIncidents: When enabled, the storyteller can send a lost survivor carrying a dormant Marked Virus infection. The survivor appears normal until the dormant mark activates.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_lostSurvivorFrequency: Multiplier for how often Lost Survivor incidents occur. Set to 0 to disable.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_dormantMarkMinDaysDes: Minimum in-game days before the dormant mark can activate.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_dormantMarkMaxDaysDes: Maximum in-game days before the dormant mark will activate.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_dormantMarkTriggerMul: Multiplier for trigger chances (combat damage, near-death, witnessing other transformations, Crossed signal proximity). Higher values make activation more likely.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_dormantMarkAlphaChanc: Chance that the transformed survivor is an Alpha variant (spawns escorting Crossed on activation). Doubled for prisoner survivors.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_dormantMarkGroupVaria: Chance that multiple dormant carriers activate simultaneously. Set to 0 to disable group activations.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_MarkedPrisonersDesc: Controls how the Marked Virus behaves in captured prisoners. Marked prisoners cannot be recruited, will attack wardens, harm themselves over time, and escape aggressively.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_PrisonerInfectionDesc: When enabled, Marked prisoners are unrecruitable, attack wardens during interaction, progress through self-harm stages, and escape with aggression.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_PrisonerRestraintDesc: When enabled, beds with assigned Marked prisoners gain a gizmo to restrain them with heavy chains. Restrained prisoners cannot attack, self-harm, or escape.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_prisonerInfectionChan: Chance per warden interaction that a Marked prisoner attacks and tries to infect the warden.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_PrisonerSelfHarmDesc: When enabled, Marked prisoners progressively harm themselves over time, culminating in suicide.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_prisonerSelfHarmStage: How many in-game days between self-harm stages. Each stage inflicts worse damage.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_prisonerSelfHarmSuici: How many in-game days before a Marked prisoner attempts suicide with severe self-mutilation.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_prisonerEscapeAggress: How aggressively Marked prisoners attack during prison breaks. Higher values mean they target more distant priority targets.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_PrisonerCosmeticDesc: When enabled, Marked prisoners pace, growl, scream, and pound walls. Visual only, no mechanical effects.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_prisonerEscapeChanceD: Base chance per day that a Marked prisoner independently attempts to break out. They attack and try to infect anyone nearby during the escape.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_PrisonerDebugLoggingD: Writes prisoner infection system debug messages to the RimWorld log.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_RJW_BridgeDesc: Only applies when RimJobWorld is installed. The bridge adds no hard dependency.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_RJW_AutoEnable: Auto-enable the RimJobWorld bridge when detected
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_RJW_AutoEnableDesc: Automatically turns on the bridge after RimJobWorld is found in the active mod list.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_RJW_EnableDesc: Allows adult RJW close-contact events to transmit Marked Virus and lets valid infected adults use RJW enemy assault jobs.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_rjwExposureChanceDesc: Chance that a valid RJW close-contact event involving one infected pawn exposes the other pawn.
LanguageData.CA_KillAnticipation_Desc: The predator's senses sharpen in the presence of prey. Reflexes quicken and focus intensifies with every hostile nearby.
LanguageData.CA_FreshKillSatisfaction_Desc: The rush of a clean kill. The hunt paid off.
LanguageData.CA_BloodthirstyCraving_Desc: The hunger for violence grows. It has been too long since the last hunt.
LanguageData.CA_OverwhelmingBloodlust_Desc: The battle consumed everything. There is only the kill.
LanguageData.CA_PredatorPatience_Desc: Watching. Waiting. The prey does not know it is already marked.
LanguageData.CA_LostSurvivor_Desc: A disoriented survivor has wandered to the colony's edge. They claim to have been separated from their group days ago and have been traveling alone since. Something about their story feels incomplete, but they seem grateful for shelter.
LanguageData.CA_LostSurvivor_Betrayal_Text:
The dormant Marked Virus infection in {PAWN_labelShort} has suddenly activated! The colonist you took in was carrying the pathogen without visible symptoms — until now.
{PAWN_labelShort} transforms before your eyes, joining the Marked Men. No warning. No chance to prepare. Just the terrible realization that the threat was already inside.
LanguageData.CA_DormantMark_Desc: A latent Marked Virus infection that has not yet activated. The host shows no symptoms and carries the infection without visible signs.
LanguageData.CA_BetrayedByColonist_Desc: Someone I trusted was carrying the Marked Virus. They were one of us until they weren't.
LanguageData.CA_LovedOneTurned_Desc: A lover, spouse, or close friend was taken by the Marked Virus. What was left behind wore their face but was not them anymore.
LanguageData.CA_SuspiciousOfColonists_Desc: If one of them was carrying the infection without knowing, any of them could be.
LanguageData.CA_MercifulKill_Desc: I put down a colonist before they could turn. It was the right call, but that does not make it easier.
LanguageData.CA_MarkedPrisoner_RecruitBlocked: The Marked Virus has completely overwritten {PAWN_labelShort}'s will. They can no longer be recruited, their mind is no longer their own.
LanguageData.CA_MarkedPrisoner_SelfHarm_Bruise: {PAWN_labelShort} slams their body against the cell walls and floor, leaving dark, spreading bruises across their skin.
LanguageData.CA_MarkedPrisoner_SelfHarm_Cut: {PAWN_labelShort} digs their nails into their own flesh, tearing shallow wounds that weep blood.
LanguageData.CA_MarkedPrisoner_SelfHarm_Mutilate: {PAWN_labelShort} savagely tears at their own body, mutilating themselves beyond recognition.
LanguageData.CA_MarkedPrisoner_Suicide: {PAWN_labelShort} has killed themselves. The Marked Virus drove them to a final, violent end rather than allow capture.
LanguageData.CA_MarkedPrisoner_DeathReason_Suicide: Self-inflicted death driven by the Marked Virus
LanguageData.CA_MarkedPrisoner_DeathReason_NeckSnap: Self-inflicted neck snap driven by the Marked Virus
LanguageData.CA_MarkedPrisoner_DeathReason_BloodLoss: Self-inflicted fatal blood loss driven by the Marked Virus
LanguageData.CA_MarkedPrisoner_DeathReason_OrganFailu: Self-inflicted critical organ damage driven by the Marked Virus
LanguageData.CA_MarkedPrisoner_CosmeticScream: {PAWN_labelShort} lets out an inhuman, guttural scream that echoes through the cell block.
LanguageData.CA_MarkedPrisoner_CosmeticGrowl: {PAWN_labelShort} paces the cell, growling and muttering in a language no one recognizes.
LanguageData.CA_MarkedPrisoner_CosmeticLaugh: {PAWN_labelShort} bursts into manic, hollow laughter that raises the hairs on the back of your neck.
LanguageData.CA_MarkedPrisoner_CosmeticPound: {PAWN_labelShort} pounds against the cell walls with bloody fists, testing for weaknesses.
LanguageData.CA_RestrainPrisonerDesc: Restrain this Marked prisoner with heavy chains. Restrained prisoners cannot attack, self-harm, or escape, but the virus continues to progress.
LanguageData.CA_ReleasePrisonerDesc: Remove the restraints from this prisoner. They will resume attacking wardens, self-harming, and attempting escape.
LanguageData.CA_PrisonerRestrained: {PAWN_labelShort} has been restrained with heavy chains. They struggle against the bindings but cannot break free.
